Who we are

A preschool with heart, in the hills of Shillong

Since March 2012, Happy Feet has dedicated itself to nurturing children through their most formative years — building confidence, curiosity, and a genuine love of learning.

Our story

Happy Feet make Happy People

Happy Feet School is a distinguished private preschool situated in Pohkseh, Shillong. Since its inception in March 2012, our institution has been dedicated to nurturing children aged 3 and above. Our educational approach centres around fostering creativity and learning through play, while instilling positive social adaptability in our students across diverse circumstances.

Happy Feet transcends the realm of a mere Playschool. It is a secure, welcoming, and nurturing haven of curiosity where children are encouraged to flourish and evolve through engaging and developmentally fitting endeavours.

When our students complete their time with us, they are well-prepared for formal school — confidently embracing new experiences, with self-assurance, strong interpersonal skills, and a well-developed vocabulary.

Our philosophy

Learning that comes from doing

We firmly believe that every child has the potential to succeed when given the opportunity. We recognise that children's learning is enriched through firsthand encounters — so our curriculum is designed around exactly that.

🎨

Play-based learning

Art, music, storytelling, and hands-on exploration are woven into every school day — stimulating imagination and nurturing a genuine love of learning from the very start.

💪

Whole-child development

We develop gross motor skills, fine motor control, and sensory perception through purposeful activity — building the whole child, not just academic ability.

🤝

Social & emotional growth

We nurture resilience, emotional intelligence, and positive social adaptability — so children are ready for new experiences and the challenges ahead in formal school.

🏠

A safe second home

Happy Feet is designed to feel warm and secure. We actively address separation anxiety with patience and care, ensuring every child settles happily into school life.

📖

School readiness

Children leave Happy Feet with self-assurance, strong interpersonal skills, and a well-developed vocabulary — confident and fully prepared for Class 1 and beyond.

🔄

Current best practices

We stay current with evolving educational practices and trends, ensuring children receive a modern, thoughtful approach to early childhood education.

Our Leadership

The people behind Happy Feet

Mrs G Mordani
Headmistress & Co-founder
Formerly of St Edmund's A.M. School · At Happy Feet since 2012
A note from the Headmistress

"If a child enters the school gates happily and leaves the premises reluctantly, that is a sure sign that the school is a happy place."

This is exactly what happens at Happy Feet. Our children come eagerly to school and are reluctant to go back home.

When I retired from St Edmund's A.M. School in 2010, I was a little apprehensive of what retired life would look like. Bah Gideon and Marnie came as a blessing when they asked me to start a play school — I couldn't have asked for more. The offer was challenging, but not impossible. With the support of my sons and my late husband, everything fell into place, and Happy Feet was born.

It was so exciting when forms began to go rapidly. We did not have to advertise — people got to know about Happy Feet by word of mouth. We celebrated when the first 50 forms were submitted!

Happy Feet is a happy place. The children's shouts of joy and excitement resonate across the campus. We never pressurise our children — we let them move at their own pace, keeping in mind that each child is different.

School is therapeutic for most of us. We forget all our worries once we are among the children. It is so gratifying when they put their arms around us — they are so full of love and affection. It brings tears to our eyes.

May God continue to shower His blessings on Happy Feet.

With love and gratitude,
Mrs G Mordani
A note from the Founder

"Happy Feet makes Happy People — and happy people make the world a better place."

Happy Feet was founded on a simple but powerful belief: that the first years of a child's life are the most formative, and that every child deserves to experience joy, warmth, and belonging from their very first day of school.

When we started Happy Feet in 2012, we wanted to create something different — not just a playschool, but a community. A place where children feel safe to explore, teachers feel proud of their work, and parents feel genuinely welcomed as partners in their child's growth.

Over the years, we have been humbled by the trust Shillong's families have placed in us. Watching generation after generation of Happy Feet children grow into confident, caring individuals is the greatest reward this school could ever offer.

We remain committed to that founding vision — and to every child who walks through our gates.

With warmth,
Marnie Barkataki Batkhar
Founder & Director, Happy Feet Playschool

Our programmes

Tailored for each stage of early childhood

Nursery
Ages 3 and above · 9:15 – 11:30 am

Our Nursery programme is where your child's school journey begins. Through play-based learning, gentle routines, and warm teacher relationships, children build confidence, social skills, and a genuine love of learning.

Apply for Nursery →
Lower KG
Progressing from Nursery · 9:15 am – 12:00 pm

Lower KG builds on the foundations of Nursery, developing language, cognitive, and social skills in a more structured environment. Children grow in confidence and independence — fully prepared for formal primary school.

Admission via Nursery progression only
